title: Father's skills as builder and healer
summary: Father could build anything, collected rent, and treated a sick man at home.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What did he do for the living?

Well, he was, I would say, he's all around, because he could do anything with a house. He could build any kind of building. He could do repairs and all that, you know. And I remember the time he knew a lot about, he wasn't no doctor, but he knew a lot about curing people with things, you know. Because I remember they had a man just come to our house. I remember his name, his name was Mr. Sims. And the man had a big hole in his side there. And he had, he said he had been every doctor he could find, and he said he could find a cure for him, you know. My daddy used to, you see the way the house was, we would live in one side, which was the room in the kitchen.
It was just one big room in the kitchen?

Yeah, it was the room in the kitchen. See, it was the room in the kitchen, it was full place, the room in the kitchen on this side, one on this side. Right. One outside and one here. Okay. Well, they had some people living next door to us, we living upstairs. We living in the room in the kitchen, all of us.
So all of y'all lived in one room?

Rum in the kitchen, yes, yes. One big room. Yeah, and so what happened, the people next door moved. My daddy cut a wall on the other side so that gave us full rooms. You understand? Yeah. Well he could do that because the man, the landlord, he had my daddy in charge, had him collect the rent for him.

And he'd come collect until my daddy told me he wanted that side. So afterwards, he, the floor, like the kitchen here and the kitchen on this side, the room here and the room, he took the room in on the far side for his personal room, see.

And when he come out of the room, he locks it. We couldn't go in there. In other words, we all had three rooms to our room. Right. You know, two rooms in that kitchen on this side. Yeah. So what he would do, he had all that together, but it took time this man came, you know, and he'd bring the man in the room and they'd stay in there a while. I don't know what he'd do, tell me that. He must be treating him or something.
Yeah. But anyway, the man got killed, you know. Your father must have known some kind of folk medicine. Something, something.
